caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with a repeating geometric and floral pattern, primarily rendered in red, green, and shades of gray. The design features large diamond shapes arranged diagonally, each filled with detailed gray floral motifs resembling roses and leaves. Superimposed on alternating diamonds are symmetrical, stylized floral starbursts composed of large green leaves and red petals, radiating from circular red centers. Each of these starbursts is accented by curved lines made of small green dots and smaller red leaf shapes extending outward. At the junctions of the diamonds, green and red corner motifs accentuate the pattern. The lower edge of the fabric is bordered with two horizontal, zigzag rows of red triangular shapes pointing upward. The overall composition is structured and repetitive, using a limited color palette and intricate linework to define both the colored and uncolored sections.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
